it: Dall'ammasso che si sgretola schizza fuori qualcosa!

it: name(tc) + " ha ripreso conoscenza per un attimo!"

jp: 倒したはずの怪物がみるみる再生していく！これではキリがない！一時撤退し、対策を練った方がいいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "倒したはずの怪物がみるみる再生していく！これではキリがない！一時撤退し、対策を練った方がいいだろう。"
en: The enemy you thought you had struck down revives instantly before your eyes! There's no way to defeat it! You should withdraw for now and develop countermeasures to its regeneration.
en_grezzo: "The enemy you thought you had struck down revives instantly before your eyes! There's no way to defeat it! You should withdraw for now and develop countermeasures to its regeneration."
it: Il mostro che credevi abbattuto si rigenera a vista d'occhio! Così non se ne viene a capo! Meglio ritirarsi e studiare una contromossa.

jp: 突然、手持ちの栗をひったくられた！
jp_grezzo: "突然、手持ちの栗をひったくられた！"
en: Suddenly, someone snatched your chestnuts from your bag!
en_grezzo: "Suddenly, someone snatched your chestnuts from your bag!"
it: Di colpo ti hanno strappato di mano le castagne!

jp: 「栗を粗末にしたのは…お前だなああっ！！」

en_grezzo: "The seal of this level is now broken!"
it: Il sigillo di questo piano si è spezzato!

jp: あなたは無事に護衛の任務を終えた。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは無事に護衛の任務を終えた。"

en_grezzo: "The color of your engraved Death-Crest is changing...!"
it: Il colore del Segno letale che porti inciso sta cambiando...!

jp: 死紋が刻まれていなかったので能力値の減少はないが…。
jp_grezzo: "死紋が刻まれていなかったので能力値の減少はないが…。"
en: There was no Death-Crest engraved on you before death, so there was no reduction in your status...
en_grezzo: "There was no Death-Crest engraved on you before death, so there was no reduction in your status..."
it: Non avevi il Segno letale inciso addosso, quindi le caratteristiche non calano, però...

jp_grezzo: "あなたの身体に死紋が刻まれた！"
en: Death-Crest is carved on your body!
it: Sul tuo corpo è stato inciso il Segno letale!

jp_grezzo: "【 刻死紋状態で死亡すると能力値が永続低下する。睡眠を取るまで消えない。 】"
en: < If you die with the Death-Crest engraved, your stats will permanently drop. It doesn't go away until you sleep. >
en_grezzo: "< If you die with the Death-Crest engraved, your stats will permanently drop. It doesn't go away until you sleep. >"
it: < Se muori con il Segno letale inciso, le caratteristiche calano per sempre. Non svanisce finché non dormi. >
